verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents an in-product agent that can analyze your workspace and run scheduled reports such as deliverability reports, segment audits and broadcast recaps (also listed as Daily Routines on the pricing page). It also helps build segments from plain-text descriptions and answers questions in Slack, so the core of in-product AI insights and suggestions is delivered. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of what the insights and suggestions actually contain (e.g., proactive recommendations or performance analysis output), and any independent or hands-on corroboration that the agent's analysis works well.
